description.value: A 1,600-metre sand-and-pebble beach on the Strait of Juan de Fuca with sweeping Olympic Mountain views and gray whale sightings during migration; year-round camping via Highway 14, but facilities are pit toilets only.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms year-round vehicle-accessible camping with fresh water, pit toilets, and a sani-station (OSM sani=yes corroborated), plus a 'Book camping' link and reservation policies section confirming reservations are accepted. OSM internet_access=no is consistent with the remote park setting and no charging infrastructure is mentioned on the website. No hiker/biker-specific sites, showers, food, laundry, or bike amenities are referenced anywhere.
concerns: OSM operator is 'R.L.C. Enterprize Ltd.' and OSM email (office@rlcparks.ca) belongs to the private operator, but the listed website is the BC Parks government page — these represent two different entities managing/describing the same site.
Sani-station is explicitly not available in the winter season per website.
No civic address recorded in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established BC Parks campground on Highway 14, a primary Vancouver Island cycling corridor, with year-round camping, potable water, and reservations — a practical and scenic overnight stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Pit toilets are the stated toilet facility; showers are not mentioned. The park is approximately 11km from Jordan River and 20km west of Sooke, with no on-site food services mentioned.

wow_evidence: 1,600-metre sand-and-pebble beach on the Strait of Juan de Fuca...gray whale sightings during migration; year-round camping via Highway 14
